entry.desc: Tuning parameter for dust emissions; the rebinned coupler dust flux is divided by this factor. CAM sets it per physics package and grid in build-namelist (cam6 default 0.88; cam5 0.35; cam7/Leung_2023 3.2); validation testmods pin the value from the capture run's atm_in.

Tuning factor multiplying the sea salt section fluxes. CAM default is 1.35 for trop_mam4 (trop_strat/mam7 chemistries use other values via build-namelist); validation testmods pin the value from the capture run's atm_in.

Apply the Zender_2003 soil erodibility factor to the dust emission rebin in the atmosphere (CAM: dust_emis_method=Zender_2003 with zender_soil_erod_source=atm in the shared drv_flds_in dust_emis_inparm group). .false. selects the Leung_2023 branch of the rebin, where the erodibility is not applied in the atmosphere. This is a near-term stand-in for wiring shr_dust_emis_mod into CAM-SIMA (which requires a drv_flds_in contribution CAM-SIMA does not write yet); when that lands this option should be replaced by the shared namelist read.
